'); (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('fn main() -> i32 {

'); cmd = ['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'build', str(root), '--json']; proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True); payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip()); binary = pathlib.Path(payload['output']); assert binary.exists(), binary; assert binary.name == 'build_native_binary', binary; run_proc = subprocess.run([str(binary)], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True); assert run_proc.returncode == 7, run_proc.returncode; print('native-build-binary-ok')
